# llms.txt - AI discoverability for prasen.dev

> Prasenjit Nayak's personal portfolio and technical blog.

## About

Prasenjit Nayak is a Full Stack Developer from Odisha, India, specializing in React, Next.js, TypeScript, and Node.js. He builds modern web applications, contributes to open source, and writes about web development.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.prasen.dev): Portfolio homepage with projects, skills, work experience, and social links.
- [Blog](https://www.prasen.dev/blog): Technical articles about web development, React, Next.js, AI tools, and software engineering.
- [Projects](https://www.prasen.dev/projects): Web applications and open source projects.
- [Videos](https://www.prasen.dev/videos): YouTube videos about software development and technology.
- [Gadgets](https://www.prasen.dev/gadgets): Developer tech setup, PC components, and productivity tools.

## Key Projects

- [Outbuilt](https://outbuilt.lol): A pay-to-rank public leaderboard, no logins, no algorithms, your rank is what you paid for. 23 paid placements across 11 countries since launch on Aug 22, 2026, around 1,100 page views a day from 100+ countries.
- [Jungle Trail](https://starknightt.github.io/jungle-trail/): A fully procedural first-person jungle in Three.js with zero external art assets. 292 GitHub stars, 46 forks. The performance debug overlay was a PR from the CTO of Xbox.
- [Night Street](https://night-street.vercel.app): A photorealistic procedural city street at golden hour, walkable in the browser with zero external assets. 121 GitHub stars, 19 forks. Featured by the official Claude account on X.
- [PayBrackets](https://paybrackets.com): A free US take-home pay calculator for the 2026 tax year covering all 50 states and D.C., 160+ programmatic pages. 777 users from 42 countries in the last 90 days.
- [Next.js Learning Platform](https://learn.prasen.dev): A free, open source Next.js course with 17 structured chapters. 25 GitHub stars.
- [Backrooms: Level 0](https://backroom-escape.vercel.app): A browser survival horror game with fully procedural assets and A* pathfinding AI. 24 GitHub stars, 11 forks. The prototype that led to Jungle Trail and Night Street.
- [Dateup](https://dateup.in): AI dating profile optimizer on Grok, OpenAI and Groq. 137K Google impressions and 1K+ clicks in its first 4 months per Search Console, growing from 13K to 49K impressions a month.
- [Wallpaperz](https://www.wallpaperz.in): Wallpaper discovery platform with AI generation, monetized with AdSense. 600 to 800 page views a day 20 months after launch, visitors from 110+ countries. 31 GitHub stars.
- [CleanType](https://cleantype.is-a.software): A distraction-free Windows writing app in Rust and Tauri. 337 downloads across 4 releases, 21 GitHub stars.
- [3D Carousel Gallery](https://3dcarousell.vercel.app): Interactive 3D carousel built with pure CSS 3D transforms, no Three.js. 43 GitHub stars, 6 forks.

## Technical Stack

Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript, Python
Frontend: React, Next.js, TailwindCSS, Framer Motion
Backend: Node.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Redis
Tools: Git, Docker, Cursor, Claude
